column1: # F14 (u5-engine#47): a party loaded with every member asleep (status 'S'),
# then left alone. Measures whether, when and how the stock wakes it - turn
# count, hour, random roll or a key - for cleak/u5-spec#299 Q23. The first
# three minutes send no key at all; Space (Pass) presses follow after that.
# Measured 2026-10-19: both sides draw an encounter on the first slept pass,
# so this beat set exercises the combat asleep arm rather than the overworld
# one - the stock panel turns a member `G` the moment the 1-in-16 roll wakes
# it mid-fight. The encounter itself is random, so beats are not expected to
# This scenario is a lottery, and no re-seed can make it otherwise. Tried
# 2026-10-20: the same party at 12:00 (hour and snapshot bytes 12), where
# `encounters.md §3` gives the party's tile (0x14 at 81,106) threshold 1 and
# so no encounter. Neither side wakes on the overworld, and the slept passes
# run back to back with the clock advancing: the stock was already in the dark
# at the arrival shot six seconds after the load, and both sides showed the
# next day (4-6) at idle1 - and both then drew an encounter in the night hours.
# §3 gives every surface tile a threshold of at least 3 at hours 0..4 (2 in 30
# per probe) and the underworld 3 at every hour, so a slept overworld party
# always reaches a night and an encounter within seconds; only how soon, and
# which creatures, varies. The beats compare the combat asleep arm after that
# draw, and a run that does not agree has measured nothing and must be re-run.
# requires-seed: the party on the Britannia overworld with every active member's status Sleeping
